rationale: CR-001 is resolved. RecordInput now alternates between two sr-only role=status regions, so every message — including a repeated identical one — is written into a region that was previously empty and is therefore re-announced. The fix was driven test-first: the new test 'writes a repeated identical message into a previously empty region so it is announced again' failed against the reviewed baseline (both removals landed in region index 0) and passes after the change; the full src/components/form suite is green at 86/86. No new high-risk issue in the fix-up diff: no timers, no imperative announcer, no singleton — the precedent from EPMCDME-8527 is respected; the regions stay sr-only so there is no visual change; FilesDropzone was deliberately not touched because its message is a pure function of a count that only changes when the effect fires, so it cannot emit two identical consecutive strings.
